confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Xiamen and coastal Fujian price levels, not inspected listings. Restaurant and beer anchors are more reliable than hostel and hotel anchors, which vary by district, season and booking channel. July is peak season for Gulangyu and the coast, so accommodation may run higher than these figures. FX: the 0.6955 USD per AUD value (15 Oct 2026, 4.00 pm) was surfaced in search results attributed to the RBA exchange-rates overview page. I did not open that page directly, and a third-party site reports a later 0.6947 figure for 16 Oct 2026 that I could not verify on rba.gov.au.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general price levels in mid-sized coastal Chinese tourist cities in Fujian and Guangdong (for example Fuzhou and Quanzhou), adjusted to Xiamen's position as a tourist destination with prices somewhat above inland cities. No specific comparable listings were checked.
